description: Steamed Whole Fish Cantonese is a quintessential dish celebrating the freshness of seafood with minimal fuss. This classic preparation highlights the fishs natural sweetness, complemented by aromatic ginger, scallions, and a savory soy sauce dressing. It is a healthy, elegant, and incredibly flavorful centerpiece for any meal.

ingredients.notes: half cut into 2-inch lengths, half julienned

instructions.title: Prepare the Fish
instructions.text: Pat the cleaned fish completely dry with paper towels. Make two to three shallow diagonal slits on both sides of the fish. Rub a pinch of salt and white pepper all over the fish, including the cavity. Place 2-3 slices of ginger and a few pieces of scallion into the fish cavity.

instructions.title: Set Up for Steaming
instructions.text: Arrange the remaining ginger slices and 2-inch scallion pieces on a heatproof plate that fits comfortably into your steamer. Place the prepared fish on top of the ginger and scallions. This elevates the fish, allowing steam to circulate evenly.

instructions.title: Steam the Fish
instructions.text: Bring water to a rolling boil in a wok or large pot fitted with a steamer rack. Carefully place the plate with the fish onto the steamer rack. Cover tightly and steam for 8-12 minutes, depending on the thickness and size of the fish. The fish is cooked when the flesh turns opaque and flakes easily with a fork.

instructions.title: Prepare the Sauce and Garnish
instructions.text: While the fish is steaming, whisk together the light soy sauce and sesame oil in a small bowl. Prepare the julienned ginger and scallions for garnish. Have the fresh cilantro ready if using.

instructions.title: Assemble the Dish
instructions.text: Once the fish is cooked, carefully remove the plate from the steamer. Discard the cooked ginger and scallions from under and inside the fish, as well as any accumulated liquid on the plate. This removes any fishy odors. Arrange the fresh julienned ginger and scallions over the top of the steamed fish.

instructions.title: Sizzle and Serve
instructions.text: Heat the cooking oil in a small pan or wok over high heat until it just begins to smoke. Carefully pour the hot oil over the julienned ginger and scallions on the fish; this will sizzle and release their aroma. Immediately pour the prepared soy sauce mixture over the fish. Garnish with fresh cilantro, if desired, and serve hot with steamed rice.

tips: Always use a very fresh whole fish for the best flavor and texture; check for clear eyes and bright red gills.
Do not oversteam the fish, as it will become tough and dry. The cooking time will vary based on the fishs thickness.
Ensure your steaming plate is elevated enough to allow proper steam circulation, and discard any fishy liquid after steaming for a cleaner taste.
